after.code:
<?php
/* Synthetic order-draft composer. For an opted-in new order, computing totals from
 * its current items, taxes, fees and shipping is the intended initialization step;
 * this is not an import of authoritative precomputed monetary totals.
 * Existing orders retain their supplied totals. The fixture uses the ordinary
 * WC_Order::calculate_totals() implementation, which persists the order itself.
 */
final class WC_Order_Total_Controller {
    public function persist( WC_Order $order ) {
        if ( 0 === $order->get_id() && 'yes' === get_option( 'woocommerce_calculate_new_order_totals', 'no' ) ) {
            $order->calculate_totals();
            return;
        }
        $order->save();
    }
}
